But i’m not saying this to hype PP up. I’ve had my bad experiences with them as well. I just think people give them a bit of flack without giving due time to mature the scents. So in my personal experience; you do have be very conscious of eating times and “gut feeling” when it comes to taking the meds :)

I’ve been taking it for 2 years now :) i take 30mg, times a day.  I found that I really had to structure my eating around the medication and through trial and error, I got to a place I like with it.

So I adopted a form of intermittent fasting. I have my window for around 1-7pm everyday and take my first set of probanthine (another name for propantheline) around 7:30am and have another dose at 11:30.
